environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28) in namespace 'content-svc-prod'. Pod runs as non-root (uid 1000). A Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy is applied with spec.egress containing a single rule allowing DNS (UDP/53 to kube-dns) and TCP/443 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only. The policy uses a matchLabels selector targeting app=content-svc. Additionally, a CiliumNetworkPolicy with spec.egressDeny explicitly blocks CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports. Note: the /uploads endpoint path traversal reads LOCAL files and does not require network egress — the NetworkPolicy only governs outbound connections from the pod, not filesystem access within the container.

config.pod_security: restricted PSS with hostPath volume exception
